issue.title: Compare mode: Improve compare mode icon

comments.body:
Hi! I’d like to work on this issue.

I reviewed the current Compare entry points in `src/lib/ui/CompareFloatingButton.svelte` and `src/routes/products/[barcode]/ProductHeader.svelte`. Both currently use `@iconify-svelte/mdi/compare` at `h-5 w-5`.

My proposal is to replace that icon consistently in both places with `@iconify-svelte/mdi/swap-horizontal`. The two opposing horizontal arrows communicate comparing two items side-by-side more directly than the current split-style compare glyph, while staying within the project’s existing MDI/Iconify dependency. I would keep the existing Compare text, `title`, and `aria-label` behavior unchanged, and verify the icon at the current mobile and desktop sizes.

If this direction looks good, could I be assigned #1660 before I start the implementation?

**AI usage disclosure:** I’m using ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol) as a primary coding assistant and Google Antigravity CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro as a read-only second reviewer. I will review and test all changes myself and take responsibility for the submitted code.

Hi! I’d like to work on this issue as well. I noticed that someone has already expressed interest, so I wanted to check whether the issue is currently assigned or still available.

If it’s still available, I’d be happy to work on the proposed icon update.
